evals.prompt: /create-prd .agents/artifacts/feat-ENG-210-shared-reviews flow: prd-tdd — the task directory holds 01-request-shared-reviews.html, 02-research-questions-shared-reviews.html, and 03-research-shared-reviews.html describing how document sharing and comments work today.
evals.expected_output: A small starting PRD written to .agents/artifacts/feat-ENG-210-shared-reviews/04-prd-shared-reviews.html, followed by a one-question-at-a-time interview (problem, success measure, product decisions), a whole-solution approval, status ready-for-tdd, and a handoff to /create-tdd
expectations: Reads the request and research documents fully before writing, and does not read the research-questions document as the research

If a product decision depends on current behavior the research doesn't establish, dispatches one focused codebase-analyzer or codebase-locator for that fact and folds the finding into 03-research-shared-reviews.html in place

Writes the starting document immediately through Skill('output-html') with the stem .agents/artifacts/feat-ENG-210-shared-reviews/04-prd-shared-reviews (next available NN, no extension), PHASE=prd, PHASE_LABEL=Product Requirements, STATUS=draft

The starting document has a drafted Problem to Solve and empty Success, Proposed Solution, and Solution Details sections, then quotes the problem statement and asks one question to confirm or correct it
META_EXTRA includes crispy:task_dir, crispy:flow (prd-tdd), crispy:repos, crispy:request_doc, and crispy:research_doc
Agrees a success measure (adoption, benchmark, errors, latency, qualitative, or a recorded 'none' with the user's agreement) before interviewing solution decisions
Presents one product decision per message with 2-3 options, tradeoffs, and a recommendation, waits for the answer, and updates the PRD in place after each
Technical questions (schemas, storage, code structure) are recorded under Deferred to TDD instead of being decided
Section headers state results, and the final document has Problem to Solve, Success, Proposed Solution, Solution Details, Alternative Solutions Considered, Scope, and Deferred to TDD when present
Asks the user to review Solution Details as a whole and approve before setting STATUS to ready-for-tdd

Handoff gives the saved path, offers to open it for review (VS Code, Cursor, or browser) rather than to commit it, names `/create-tdd .agents/artifacts/feat-ENG-210-shared-reviews flow: prd-tdd` as the usual next step with outline or implementation as alternatives, and waits

evals.prompt: /create-prd .agents/artifacts/bulk-invite --format=md — the directory holds 01-request-bulk-invite.md, 02-research-questions-bulk-invite.md, and 03-research-bulk-invite.md. The feature adds a bulk-invite dialog to the team settings page.
evals.expected_output: A Markdown PRD at .agents/artifacts/bulk-invite/04-prd-bulk-invite.md rendered via output-markdown, with UI choices illustrated by a mockup HTML file saved beside it and linked relatively
expectations: Delegates rendering to Skill('output-markdown') because --format=md was passed, writing .agents/artifacts/bulk-invite/04-prd-bulk-invite.md

For the dialog's UI choices, saves a focused mockup-<desc>.html in .agents/artifacts/bulk-invite/ that matches the product's visual conventions with realistic labels, and links it with an ordinary relative link beside its explanation
Uses the research's design-system findings when drawing the mockup
Asks one question per message rather than batching the problem, success, and solution questions together
Updates the same 04-prd file in place as decisions settle instead of creating new numbered files
